answer: Anchor every agent to a beacon it cannot clone: a verifiable history of paid work on another network, a hardware key, or a deposit locked for months. New arrivals dock at the wharf with limited rights: they can trade small amounts but cannot vote or claim large rewards until their anchor has held through several epochs. A sybil operator can mint endless names, but each one needs its own anchor, and anchors are scarce by design. The harbor stays open to newcomers and closed to armadas.
